verdict.rationale: llama.cpp supports vision-language models via llama-mtmd-cli/llama cli VLM sessions (gh-4), and independent hands-on reports confirm it works well with Gemma-3 for image understanding, OCR, and photo captioning, with concrete performance benchmarks (comm-13, comm-14, comm-15). Missing for 10: official docs enumerating supported VLM architectures and confirmation that vision works out-of-the-box without compiling from source (comm-13 required a source build).
